faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUSAT Course in Charge recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CUSAT Course in Charge position is 15th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Course in Charge post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech in Marine/Mechanical Engineering/ Naval Architecture or an Extra First Class certificate of Competency (MOT) with significant relevant experience. A Ph.D or M.Tech in Marine Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Course in Charge position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Course in Charge position at Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) as per the latest notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Course in Charge role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Course in Charge position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 148,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CUSAT Course in Charge recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is ₹950/-, while for SC/ST candidates, it is ₹195/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CUSAT Course in Charge recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience required for the Course in Charge post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience is required, with at least 2 years as Chief Engineer or 5 years as a Reader in Marine Engineering.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any age-related information or relaxation criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of CUSAT?
faq.answer: The official website of Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) is http://cusat.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are needed for the online application?
faq.answer: Candidates will need to upload essential documents such as a photograph, signature, and relevant educational and experience certificates in the prescribed format during the online application process.
